svg.title: Build Evidence, Sell Support, Separate Award Exposure
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-evidence-to-paid-support; chart type: process_flow; title: Build Evidence, Sell Support, Separate Award Exposure; subtitle: Five operating stages from lawful public signals to paid counsel work; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Public anomalies are research leads rather than established violations. Retainers pay for defined analytical services. An analyst does not acquire statutory claimant eligibility merely by preparing a dossier for someone else.; caption: Use Python sqlite3, hashlib, and csv for reproducible research; preserve source provenance before transforming records. Only licensed relator counsel files an FCA complaint under 31 U.S.C. § 3730(b)(2). Route SEC Form TCR and IRS Form 211 submissions through counsel as an operating requirement.; stages: label: Acquire Lawful Records; value: Step 1: document source and access authority; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect CMS Part B/D, Open Payments, SAM.gov, and lawfully obtained import-manifest records. Record publication dates, source URLs, permitted uses, and SHA-256 hashes; exclude improperly acquired records.; label: Rank Explainable Signals; value: Step 2: normalize before scoring anomalies; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Normalize specialties, geography, utilization, coding changes, contract modifications, and shipment units. Use peer-adjusted comparisons and negative controls; an outlier without context is not a fraud conclusion.; label: Corroborate Claim Elements; value: Step 3: tie allegations to primary evidence; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Build a claim ledger linking dates, actors, amounts, government payment requests, and supporting records. Track FOIA provenance and disclosure history; public FOIA material can affect public-disclosure analysis.; label: Contract Counsel Support; value: Step 4: bill defined forensic deliverables; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use paid scopes for reproducible notebooks, claim reconstruction, exhibits, and ongoing analytical support. Invoice service milestones independently of litigation outcomes and preserve conflict checks.; label: Segregate Contingent Outcomes; value: Step 5: restrict sealed materials and award ledgers; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Counsel controls filing, service, court orders, and permitted disclosure. Maintain least-privilege matter workspaces. Carry potential awards at zero in operating cash budgets until actual eligible proceeds arrive.

Assumptions: Public anomalies are research leads rather than established violations. Retainers pay for defined analytical services. An analyst does not acquire statutory claimant eligibility merely by preparing a dossier for someone else.
